title: Splunk Low-Priv Search as nobody SplunkDeploymentServerConfig App
author: Rod Soto, Deivid Aguero
description: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 9.3.1, and 9.2.0 versions below 9.2.3, and Splunk Cloud Platform versions below 9.2.2403.103, 9.1.2312.200, 9.1.2312.110 and 9.1.2308.208, a low-privileged user that does not hold the “admin” or “power” Splunk roles could run a search as ”nobody” in the SplunkDeploymentServerConfig app allowing access to potentially restricted data.
